newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Westpac cuts variable mortgage rate.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Westpac cuts variable mortgage rate.

text.p: Westpac Banking Corp said on Wednesday it would cut its variable rate housing loan by 0.5 percentage points, the full amount of the Reserve Bank of Australia's cut in official interest rates announced earlier in the day.
Westpac said the new rates apply to new borrowers from December 17 and to existing customers from January 17, 1997.
The Premium Option loan was now 8.25 percent, the First Option loan 7.29 percent, the Basic Option 7.55 percent and the Investment Property Loan 8.35 percent.
Westpac said reduced interest rates for business borrowers would be announced shortly while deposit rates would also be reviewed.
Westpac shares closed seven cents lower at A$7.25 on turnover of 4.29 million shares.
